column1: learn|/lɜːrn/|v.|学习；得知|基础|learn|learn from::向某人学习；从某事中学习;learn about::了解|We can learn a lot from our mistakes.::我们可以从错误中学到很多。|I learned about the event from a friend.::我从一位朋友那里得知了这件事。

learning|/ˈlɜːrnɪŋ/|n.|学习；学问|基础|learn|lifelong learning::终身学习;language learning::语言学习|Language learning takes time and regular practice.::语言学习需要时间和经常练习。|The library supports learning at every age.::图书馆支持各个年龄段的学习。
teach|/tiːtʃ/|v.|教；讲授|基础|teach|teach someone to do::教某人做某事;teach a lesson::授课；给人教训|My grandfather taught me to ride a bicycle.::我的祖父教我骑自行车。|She teaches science at a local school.::她在当地一所学校教科学。

teacher|/ˈtiːtʃər/|n.|教师；老师|基础|teach|a language teacher::语言教师;learn from a teacher::向老师学习|Our teacher encouraged us to ask more questions.::我们的老师鼓励我们多提问。|A good teacher makes difficult ideas easier to understand.::好老师能让难懂的观念更容易理解。
read|/riːd/|v.|阅读；读懂|基础|read|read aloud::朗读;read carefully::仔细阅读|I read a few pages before going to sleep.::我睡前会读几页书。|Please read the instructions carefully before you begin.::开始前请仔细阅读说明。

reader|/ˈriːdər/|n.|读者；阅读器|四级|read|a regular reader::经常阅读的人;an electronic reader::电子阅读器|The newspaper invites readers to share their views.::这家报纸邀请读者分享观点。|This book is suitable for young readers.::这本书适合年轻读者。
write|/raɪt/|v.|写；写作|基础|write|write down::写下;write to someone::给某人写信|Write down any new words you want to remember.::写下你想记住的所有新词。|She writes to her sister every month.::她每个月都给姐姐写信。

writer|/ˈraɪtər/|n.|作者；作家|基础|write|a young writer::年轻作家;a talented writer::有才华的作家|The writer spent years researching the story.::这位作家花了多年研究这个故事。|A talented writer can make ordinary things interesting.::有才华的作家能把平常事物写得有趣。

describe|/dɪˈskraɪb/|v.|描述；形容|四级|scrib|describe something as::将某物描述为;describe in detail::详细描述|Can you describe the place you visited?::你能描述一下你去过的地方吗？|She described the experience in great detail.::她非常详细地描述了这段经历。

description|/dɪˈskrɪpʃən/|n.|描述；说明|四级|scrib|a brief description::简短描述;a detailed description::详细描述|The website provides a brief description of each course.::网站对每门课程都有简短说明。|His description helped us find the right building.::他的描述帮助我们找到了正确的建筑。

prescribe|/prɪˈskraɪb/|v.|开处方；规定|六级|scrib|prescribe medicine::开药;prescribe a procedure::规定程序|Only a qualified professional should prescribe this medicine.::只有具备资格的专业人员才应开这种药。|The regulations prescribe how the records must be kept.::规章规定了必须如何保存记录。

prescription|/prɪˈskrɪpʃən/|n.|处方；规定的方法|六级|scrib|a doctor's prescription::医生的处方;on prescription::凭处方|You need a prescription to buy this medicine.::购买这种药需要处方。|There is no simple prescription for a successful career.::事业成功没有简单的万能方法。

manuscript|/ˈmænjuskrɪpt/|n.|手稿；原稿|六级|scrib|an original manuscript::原始手稿;submit a manuscript::提交原稿|The museum displayed the poet's original manuscript.::博物馆展出了这位诗人的原始手稿。|She submitted the manuscript to a small publisher.::她将原稿提交给了一家小型出版社。

dictate|/ˈdɪkteɪt/|v.|口述；支配；决定|六级|dict|dictate a letter::口述一封信;dictate the terms::决定条件|He dictated a short letter to his assistant.::他向助手口述了一封短信。|The weather will dictate when we can leave.::天气将决定我们什么时候能出发。

dictation|/dɪkˈteɪʃən/|n.|听写；口述|四级|dict|take dictation::记录口述;do a dictation::做听写|The class began with a short dictation.::这节课以一段简短听写开始。|The assistant took dictation during the meeting.::助手在会议期间记录了口述内容。

predict|/prɪˈdɪkt/|v.|预测；预言|四级|dict|predict the outcome::预测结果;predict a change::预测变化|It is difficult to predict the final result.::最终结果很难预测。|The model can predict changes in temperature.::这个模型能够预测温度变化。

prediction|/prɪˈdɪkʃən/|n.|预测；预言|六级|dict|make a prediction::作出预测;an accurate prediction::准确的预测|Her prediction turned out to be accurate.::她的预测结果很准确。|The report makes no prediction about next year.::这份报告没有对明年作出预测。

contradict|/ˌkɑːntrəˈdɪkt/|v.|反驳；与某事矛盾|六级|dict|contradict a statement::反驳一项陈述;contradict the evidence::与证据相矛盾|The new results contradict the earlier findings.::新结果与此前的发现相矛盾。|She did not hesitate to contradict his claim.::她毫不犹豫地反驳了他的说法。

contradiction|/ˌkɑːntrəˈdɪkʃən/|n.|矛盾；反驳|六级|dict|a clear contradiction::明显的矛盾;in contradiction to::与某事相矛盾|There is a contradiction between his words and actions.::他的言语和行动之间存在矛盾。|These facts are in contradiction to the official account.::这些事实与官方叙述相矛盾。

explain|/ɪkˈspleɪn/|v.|解释；说明|基础|explain|explain a reason::解释原因;explain to someone::向某人解释|Could you explain this idea in simpler words?::你能用更简单的词解释这个想法吗？|She explained the new rule to the team.::她向团队说明了新规则。

explanation|/ˌekspləˈneɪʃən/|n.|解释；说明|四级|explain|a clear explanation::清楚的解释;offer an explanation::作出解释|Thank you for your clear explanation.::谢谢你清楚的解释。|The company offered an explanation for the delay.::公司就延迟给出了解释。

express|/ɪkˈspres/|v.|表达；表示|四级|express|express an opinion::表达意见;express gratitude::表达感激|Everyone should have a chance to express an opinion.::每个人都应该有机会表达意见。|I wrote a letter to express my gratitude.::我写了一封信表达感激之情。

expression|/ɪkˈspreʃən/|n.|表达；表情；词语|四级|express|a facial expression::面部表情;freedom of expression::表达自由|Her facial expression showed that she was surprised.::她的面部表情表明她很惊讶。|We learned several useful expressions in class.::我们在课上学了几个有用的表达。

communicate|/kəˈmjuːnɪkeɪt/|v.|交流；传达|四级|communicate|communicate with::与某人交流;communicate clearly::清楚地传达|We communicate with our partners every week.::我们每周都与合作伙伴交流。|A good diagram can communicate a complex idea clearly.::一张好的图可以清楚地传达复杂想法。

communication|/kəˌmjuːnɪˈkeɪʃən/|n.|交流；沟通；通信|四级|communicate|effective communication::有效沟通;communication skills::沟通能力|Effective communication helps a team work well together.::有效沟通有助于团队良好协作。|The storm damaged the island's communication system.::暴风雨破坏了岛上的通信系统。

discuss|/dɪˈskʌs/|v.|讨论；商议|基础|discuss|discuss a problem::讨论问题;discuss in detail::详细讨论|We will discuss the problem after lunch.::午餐后我们会讨论这个问题。|The article discusses how cities can save energy.::这篇文章讨论了城市如何节约能源。

discussion|/dɪˈskʌʃən/|n.|讨论；商议|四级|discuss|have a discussion::进行讨论;under discussion::正在讨论中|We had a useful discussion about the proposal.::我们就这项提议进行了有益讨论。|The details are still under discussion.::细节仍在讨论中。

conclude|/kənˈkluːd/|v.|得出结论；结束|四级|conclude|conclude that::得出结论;conclude a meeting::结束会议|We concluded that more evidence was needed.::我们得出结论，认为还需要更多证据。|The speaker concluded with a question for the audience.::演讲者以一个面向听众的问题结束了发言。

conclusion|/kənˈkluːʒən/|n.|结论；结束|四级|conclude|draw a conclusion::得出结论;in conclusion::最后；总之|Do not draw a conclusion from one example.::不要仅凭一个例子就下结论。|The conclusion of the report summarizes the main findings.::报告的结尾概括了主要发现。

vocabulary|/voʊˈkæbjəleri/|n.|词汇；词汇量|四级|independent|build vocabulary::积累词汇;a wide vocabulary::丰富的词汇量|Reading regularly helps you build your vocabulary.::经常阅读有助于积累词汇。|This book introduces the vocabulary of everyday life.::这本书介绍日常生活中的词汇。
